notes: FullCPU is one original full output processor; splitCPU is one processor containing four public FF blocks plus same prefix and finalRange[0,12.7].
Serial stage calls make additional Float32 API boundaries; fullSerialCPU/splitSerialCPU preserve their endpoint effects separately.
Official full forward CPU applies tone directly from Aab[0]; public tonescale FF consumes JMh and follows a J route. Closeness alone does not uniquely prove the GPU mismatch cause.
Public h is degrees throughout; no manual degree/radian conversion occurs at FF boundaries. GPU-internal cosine/sine conversions remain official shader implementation details.
No private Aab/LMS reimplementation or self-authored ACES approximation is provided.
No original423 shader assets or52/53 evidence changed, no GPU/browser run or tolerance modification here.

limits: Diagnostic endpoints/indices only, not a new relaxed acceptance gate or display transform.
Public split CPU FFs may add hue/radian and buffer round-trips as well as J-to-A powers; closeness alone does not uniquely prove which operation caused an error.
QA assignments can affect GPU optimization; exact original/instrumented endpoint is tested and all failures retained.
No source spectrum/exposure/storage/render pipeline/HDR presentation changes. No timing or fullscene pressure test.
This tests a non-official generic arithmetic candidate, not an official OCIO certification or HDR canvas presentation.
The original colour thresholds, official Float32 inputs/CPU results, hue tables and unit/OETF gates are reused unchanged.
Stage trace must still match its uninstrumented candidate endpoint bit-for-bit.
Any timer is the tiny isolated QA transform, not production frame time; production integration is not authorized.
